summary: One entry per version of each component of the set view, written by scripts/write-units.mjs from component.json x-history (kind, consumer note, evidence) and the version's migration entry (changes). Former public names are dated in each component's aliases.json.

entries.consumer: Nothing changes without head="list". A page that writes head="list" gets the list head above the list (title row and head row, C297, C299-C301): the table draws no toolbar and no gear of its own under it, and the head raises the study's draft intents (filter.*, settings.save, entity.fields.save) through the same port.
entries.summary: List head (head="list"; owner decisions C297, C299, C300, C301; view round 2 LH-1..LH-10): a title row (name and count, views, display kind on sf-segmented, «Настроить вид», list menu by describe().permissions) and a head row (Фильтр + bookmark, filter fields as joined sf-button + sf-button-icon, Очистить, search up to 20rem, Создать split) drawn by the view from SIMAI Framework parts; windows are sf-popover on a desktop and an sf-drawer bottom sheet on a phone; the field window is the pair's filter template (SF.fieldRenderers.renderFilterField). The table draws no toolbar and no head gear under it. Draft intents of the list head study (section 7) through the same port. Without head="list" nothing changes.

entries.summary: View round 1 (D1, D3, D5-D8, PD-9): the create, view-actions, list-sort and saved-view menus open the SIMAI Framework's shared menu (SF.menu.open); the panel footers put the main action first; the toolbar's button groups are roving.js groups; every toolbar word is in lang/; the filter count is sf-button-icon badge-count; the Create row is one scheme; dates are the field renderers' reading in a time element with its machine value (format-value.js is gone); the link cell is sf-reference-link; date operators of a chip read Позже, Не раньше, Раньше, Не позже.

entries.summary: C106: the gear's window is SIMAI Framework sf-settings look="panel" (sf-settings 1.6.3), not sf-menu-context tabs with rows drawn by the table. «Поля» is its fields list -- a column shown or not (the theme's light fill and a check at the end), its order (the handle at the start, a drag or Alt+arrows, the position said), pinned on top (the Framework pin button), the panel's search -- and «Вид» its density choice (the fill alone) and switches (lines, one line, the held head, «Для всех моих таблиц» after a line). Every change applies at once as before (save {kind: columns} with reason column-visibility, column-pin or column-order; view-change); «Сбросить» puts the fields back as the window opened with them or the view to its defaults, by the tab it stands on; the window reopens on the tab it was closed on. The panel takes the gear's density (C22): the hand-set 1/2 handles and pins are gone, a size is passed only when the host wrote one; on a phone it is the bottom sheet (C106 (8), C157 (5)). The host labels column-move-label, pin-column-label, unpin-column-label, column-search-placeholder and column-search-empty-text are no longer read by the gear: sf-settings speaks its own words in the page language. The filter window keeps its tabs (its templates need what sf-settings does not offer).

entries.consumer: panel-width is a former name until 2027-01-01, mapped to the nearest drawer step with a console notice; sections-as is read by an inline view only; a page needs no defineFieldsOf before mounting the card.
entries.summary: C289 (1), (5), R250: the sections are laid out by width, not by a setting: a panel shows them as an underline sf-tabs line under the head (overflow more, «Ещё (n)»); a panel of size full and a wide inline view keep the section column at the start; on a phone they are an sf-list of rows, each opening its section with «←». sections-as applies to an inline view only. C289 (2), C157 (2): the panel is drawn at a step of the sf-drawer ladder (1/2, 1, 2) or full and never grows; panel-width is a dated former name until 2027-01-01, mapped to the nearest step with a console notice and an SF.deprecations entry. C289 (3), (6), R254: «Удалить» is the last row of the head's «⋯» menu, with «Копировать ссылку» and «Открыть на всю страницу»; a record to read has no foot, and nothing stands on the drawer's edge outside the panel. C289 (4), R252: a record to read is an sf-list-description: the label beside the value on one row, each group a heading of the list, «Изменить» in the group's heading. C289 (6): the head is one row of the drawer's control height; a record opened from another shows «← <record>» above its title as the drawer's back line (sf-drawer-back), which returns to the previous record. C289 (6): a panel the page gave no panel-label is headed by the record's name, record.label or record.title (the reference host and most pages send title); it showed the record id. The back line and the drawer's accessible name read the same name. C289 (7), C182: Save is never disabled; a Save over empty required fields or entries that are not values is refused with the message under each field and, for two or more, a summary with a link per field; a host's confirmation is asked in place with sf-confirm. C289 (8), (9), (10): the first paint keeps its boxes (no layout shift when the record comes); value buttons are 24px high at least on a phone (--sf-hit--min); the view asks the Loader for every tag it draws, so a page needs no defineFieldsOf or own defines.
